info.title: BlueCat Address Manager
info.description:
Authentication: HTTP Basic Auth (a static API token obtained once from BlueCat Address Manager, used as the password half of a username:apiToken pair).

BlueCat Address Manager DDI (DNS-DHCP-IPAM) API for managing IP address space (configurations, blocks, networks, addresses, IPv4 and IPv6), DNS (views, zones, resource records), and DHCP (ranges).

The real API base path is /api/v2 -- set it on the integration instance's server.base_path.

Source: BlueCat Address Manager RESTful v2 API Guide (docs.bluecatnetworks.com).
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 46 of 60 upstream operations covering configurations, IP blocks/networks, IP addresses, DHCP ranges, and DNS views/zones/resource records -- the core DDI CRUD surface. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.

apiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
apiKeyAuth.description: Value format: 'Basic {base64(username:apiToken)}'. Obtain the apiToken once via POST /api/v2/sessions with HTTP Basic Auth (username/password) -- the response includes a basicAuthenticationCredentials field that is the ready-to-use base64 value. Prefix it with 'Basic ' and configure it here as a static credential.
